event_timeline.event: Legacy signal history begins; signals are emitted approximately hourly.
Nineteen fallback signals with price_at_emission=0 begin an unchecked block; the evaluator skips them.
Daily accuracy commit 03a8674 increments checked_count from 1,683 to 1,697, leaves correct_count at 772 and changes accuracy from 45.9% to 45.5%; 14 records are marked incorrect at $1.25.
Latest committed XRP signal remains 2026-10-29T13:23:33Z, score 44, confidence 0, provider unavailable.

findings.statement: Main's legacy summary is 1,697 checked, 772 correct and 45.5%. The full history contains 1,716 records, of which 19 are unchecked.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: None for the stored counts; their interpretation as model skill is invalid.

findings.statement: All 19 unchecked records have price_at_emission=0, confidence 0 and fallback/no-sentiment source strings; the evaluator skips them because it requires a nonzero emission price and current price.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: The reason the emission price was zero is not recorded and cannot be attributed to a specific price provider failure.

findings.statement: The evaluator waits for a minimum age of 24 hours but checks all eligible signals against one current CoinGecko price fetched at the daily run. It does not record checked_at or price observation time; therefore the outcome horizon is variable and irrecoverable from the history schema.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: The latest daily commit provides an approximate run-time bracket for 14 records, but not the exact price quote timestamp.

findings.statement: Among 1,697 checked records, 1,119 fallback/no-sentiment signals have confidence 0 and 556 marked correct (49.69%); 578 Groq-labelled signals average confidence 0.947 and 216 marked correct (37.37%).
findings.disconfirming_evidence: These are descriptive counts under the flawed legacy scoring rule, not formal calibration or independent out-of-sample accuracy.

findings.statement: Checked score classes are 578 bullish (216 correct, 37.37%), 67 bearish (27 correct, 40.30%) and 1,052 neutral (529 correct, 50.29%). Neutral correctness means absolute price movement under 2%, not correct direction.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: No fixed horizon, class-specific baseline or independent sample adjustment exists.

findings.statement: The median signal emission interval is approximately 0.982 hours and the mean is 1.291 hours; the evaluation windows overlap substantially.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: The exact effective sample size is not calculated; this is a timestamp-cadence observation.

findings.statement: The latest committed XRP signal is 2026-10-29T13:23:33Z, score 44, confidence 0, news_score 88 and 11 news entries. Its source explicitly reports missing GitHub model credentials and Groq HTTP 429. It is approximately 37.3 hours old at this audit cutoff.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: The latest committed file may not reveal uncommitted or failed workflow attempts; no newer committed signal exists on main.

findings.statement: The legacy 45.5% figure is not a valid estimate of out-of-sample prediction skill because the outcome horizon is variable, the target rule mixes directional and neutral-band tasks, records overlap, provider failures are common and no baseline or calibration is measured.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: The descriptive hit counter remains reproducible from stored labels, but reproducibility does not make it a valid skill estimate.

latest_signal.source: sentiment unavailable; missing GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_MODELS_TOKEN; Groq HTTP 429

causal_hypotheses.name: Legacy 45.5% is not comparable prediction skill
causal_hypotheses.claim: The 45.5% hit counter cannot be used as an out-of-sample skill or calibration estimate.
causal_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: The arithmetic is reproducible; the defect is the target/horizon/evaluation design, not the division.

causal_hypotheses.name: High self-reported confidence is not calibrated
causal_hypotheses.claim: Groq-labelled signals with mean confidence 0.947 have a lower legacy hit rate (37.37%) than zero-confidence fallback signals (49.69%).
causal_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: The groups differ in score class, source availability and outcome mix; the legacy target is invalid and does not establish a statistically valid confidence-performance relationship.

causal_hypotheses.name: Provider failure dominates the committed signal history
causal_hypotheses.claim: 1,119 of 1,697 checked signals (65.9%) were generated with no sentiment provider result, with missing GitHub model credentials and Groq HTTP 429 recorded in source strings.
causal_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: The source strings establish reported failures but do not identify every upstream request, retry or provider outage interval.

causal_hypotheses.name: Overlapping forecasts inflate apparent sample size
causal_hypotheses.claim: Signals emitted at a median 0.982-hour interval have highly overlapping outcome windows and cannot be treated as 1,697 independent observations.
causal_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: The exact overlap-adjusted effective sample size has not been computed.

causal_hypotheses.name: The current XRP signal pipeline is not fit to issue a directional forecast
causal_hypotheses.claim: The latest committed signal is stale, confidence 0 and provider-unavailable; no calibrated fixed-horizon evaluation exists.
causal_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: A newer signal could exist in an uncommitted or failed run, but no newer committed main-branch signal was found.
